input.command:
cd /workspace; H=pr/head
echo "===== hook script: head vs later workspace"; diff $H/.claude/hooks/session-start/loa-context-class.sh .claude/hooks/session-start/loa-context-class.sh
echo "===== loa-status display_context_line"; diff <(sed -n '/^display_context_line() {/,/^}/p' $H/.claude/scripts/loa-status.sh) <(sed -n '/^display_context_line() {/,/^}/p' .claude/scripts/loa-status.sh)
echo "===== tool-result-clearing"; diff $H/.claude/protocols/tool-result-clearing.md .claude/protocols/tool-result-clearing.md
echo "===== context_discipline include"; diff $H/.claude/data/skill-includes/context_discipline.md .claude/data/skill-includes/context_discipline.md
echo "===== stubs"; for p in trajectory-evaluation session-continuity constructs-integration; do echo "--- $p"; diff $H/.claude/protocols/$p.md .claude/protocols/$p.md; done
echo "===== reference files"; for p in trajectory-evaluation session-continuity recommended-hooks; do echo "--- $p"; diff $H/.claude/protocols/reference/$p.md .claude/protocols/reference/$p.md | head -30; done
echo "===== hooks README row / hooks-reference row"; diff <(grep context-class $H/.claude/hooks/README.md) <(grep context-class .claude/hooks/README.md); diff <(grep context-class $H/.claude/loa/reference/hooks-reference.md) <(grep context-class .claude/loa/reference/hooks-reference.md)
echo "===== settings.json context-class entries"; grep -n -B2 -A2 'loa-context-class' .claude/settings.json | head -20
echo "===== CLAUDE.loa.md"; diff $H/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md | head -60
echo "===== constraints.json why diffs"; diff <(jq -r '.. | objects | select(has("why")) | .why' $H/.claude/data/constraints.json) <(jq -r '.. | objects | select(has("why")) | .why' .claude/data/constraints.json) | head -40
